intro.text: Hello everyone, I am Reachy. I will guide your discussion today. Please share your ideas with each other.

t1_open.text: Let's start with something to the whole group. Where do you usually work or study best?

t1_q1.text: What do you think: is it better to study alone or in a group?

t1_q2.text: What do you think: does music help you concentrate, or does it distract you?

t1_q3.text: What do you think: how often should people take breaks when they work?

t1_q4.text: What do you think: is working from home better than working in a library or at work or school?

t1_q5.text: What do you think: are to-do lists actually useful while working?

t1_q6.text: What do you think: is it a good idea to study with friends who are not in your course?

t2_open.text: Let's start with something to the whole group. Where is one place in the world you would love to visit?

t2_q1.text: What do you think: is it better to travel alone or with friends?

t2_q2.text: What do you think: are holidays better when they are planned, or spontaneous?

t2_q3.text: What do you think: is it better to visit a big city or somewhere in nature?

t2_q4.text: What do you think: should you learn some of the language before you travel to a new country?

t2_q5.text: What do you think: is a relaxing holiday better than a busy one?

t2_q6.text: What do you think: what makes a place worth visiting again?

outro.text: Thank you all. That is the end of this discussion.
